theme_and_identity.mood: Detective, investigative, warm, child-friendly, scientifically accurate (non-scary)
theme_and_identity.aesthetic: Vintage investigation board, flat-vector educational, paper/corkboard textures, layered

primary.usage: Primary UI elements, standard text on light backgrounds, main navigation

medical_maroon.usage: Medical elements, blood-related icons, symptom clue cards, red string for investigation

interactive_teal.usage: Interactive accents, hotspots, lab test clue cards, primary buttons

cream.usage: Main app background, clean card backgrounds

vintage_paper.usage: Dialog boxes, Jurnal Investigasi pages, clue cards

headings.usage: Titles, Scene Headers, Jurnal Title, Clue Categories. Provides a detective, vintage feel.

body.usage: Dialog text, descriptions, general UI text. Highly readable for Grade 8 students.

data_monospace.usage: Lab results, Jurnal timestamps, numerical medical data.

spacing_and_layout.scale: Tailwind spacing scale (p-4, p-6, p-8). Generous padding for comfortable reading.

layout_strategy.game_container: Fixed aspect ratio (16:9) container max-w-6xl mx-auto, centered on screen, hidden overflow.
layout_strategy.hud: Absolute positioning for HUD elements (Mute, Jurnal) over the main scene.
layout_strategy.dialog_section: Bottom 30% of the screen, full width within container, padding p-6.

textures.corkboard: Use cork board image with subtle noise overlay.
textures.paper: Subtle grain effect on paper-colored backgrounds (#F4EEDC).

DialogBox.style: bg-[#F4EEDC] border-t-4 border-[#1F3864] p-6 shadow-lg rounded-t-xl
DialogBox.features: Typewriter effect for text, 'Next' indicator bouncing at bottom right. Name tag overlapping top-left.

ClueCard.style: bg-white p-4 shadow-md rounded-sm border-l-4 transform transition-transform hover:scale-105
ClueCard.features: Slight random rotation (e.g., rotate-1, -rotate-2) when pinned on board. Tape or pin decoration on top edge.

Hotspot.style: w-8 h-8 rounded-full border-2 border-white bg-[#0F6674]/80 cursor-pointer shadow-lg
Hotspot.animation: animate-ping (subtle absolute pseudo-element) to draw attention.

JurnalInvestigasi_Modal.container: w-[90%] h-[90%] bg-cover bg-center rounded-xl overflow-hidden relative shadow-2xl p-8 border-4 border-[#8B1E1E]

Button.primary: bg-[#0F6674] text-white px-6 py-3 rounded-full font-bold hover:bg-[#0a4852] transition-colors shadow-md transform hover:-translate-y-1
Button.secondary: bg-[#F4EEDC] text-[#1F3864] border-2 border-[#1F3864] px-6 py-3 rounded-full font-bold hover:bg-[#1F3864] hover:text-white transition-colors

heart_pulse.animation: Scale up to 1.1 and back, duration 0.8s, ease-in-out, infinite (Framer Motion: { scale: [1, 1.1, 1] })

clue_stagger.animation: Staggered entrance, fading in and sliding up slightly (y: 20 -> 0).

dialog_typewriter.animation: Revealing characters one by one. Include a skip-to-end functionality on click.

Scene0_SplashMenu.layout: Centered flexbox. Beating heart logo. Title in Fraunces font. Stacked Button list (Mulai, Cara Bermain, dll). Avatar selection panel replaces menu on 'Mulai' click.
Scene0_SplashMenu.background: Cream background with subtle medical vectors (microscope, blood cells) floating.

Scene1_UKS.layout: Visual novel layout. Background asset (UKS). Character (Bu Nita) anchored to left or right. DialogBox anchored to bottom.
Scene1_UKS.hud: Persistent Jurnal button top-right, Mute button top-left.

Scene2_Hotspots.layout: Background asset (UKS). Rani character centered. Absolute positioned Hotspots over eyes, nails, chest, pulse.
Scene2_Hotspots.interaction: Clicking hotspot opens a modal ClueCard with symptom description and mini-quiz (multiple choice).

Scene3_LabTest.layout: Split screen or desk perspective. Left: Dr. Salma character with dialog. Right/Center: Digital lab sheet (Space Mono font).
Scene3_LabTest.interaction: Drag-and-drop mechanism for Hb, Erythrocyte, MCV values into corresponding Normal/Low boxes. Microscopic cell comparison animation running on loop above.

libraries_and_tools.motion: framer-motion (for heart pulse, clue card stagger, drag-and-drop)
libraries_and_tools.icons: lucide-react (for UI icons: Mute, Close, Notebook/Jurnal alternative)
libraries_and_tools.drag_and_drop: framer-motion (use drag prop and onDragEnd for simple drop logic, or @hello-pangea/dnd)

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on #0F6674 and #8B1E1E meets WCAG AA.
accessibility.interactions: All hotspots must be keyboard accessible (tabindex='0') and triggerable via Enter key.
accessibility.audio: Mute button must clearly indicate current state (icon-volume-2 vs icon-volume-x).

instructions_to_main_agent: Use framer-motion for smooth scene transitions (opacity 0 to 1) instead of abrupt mounting.
Implement the Jurnal Investigasi as a global state or React Context so collected clues persist across scenes.
Store progress in localStorage (e.g., unlocked_clues: [], current_scene: 1).
Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for the Jurnal modal overlay; use bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm.
For the visual novel dialog, create a reusable <DialogManager /> component that accepts an array of text strings and handles the typewriter effect and next-click logic.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='jurnal-button', data-testid='hotspot-eye').
Avoid generic centered layouts except for the main menu.
Use glass-morphism effects carefully; prefer solid paper/cork textures to fit the detective aesthetic.
Ensure layering creates depth (z-index strategy): Background -> Characters -> Dialog Box -> HUD -> Modals (Jurnal).
Never use AI assistant emoji characters for icons. Use lucide-react or provided custom assets.
